facts.value: The application is made through an online system provided and operated by uni-assist e.V. All applications for the Master of Science in Management are processed through this system.

facts.value: Applicants must submit a detailed record of all achievements completed at a university as well as the designated application form for credit transfer.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro, and Finance

facts.value: Applicants with foreign qualifications must demonstrate at least German language skills at the level of the Central Intermediate Examination (C1).
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro, and Finance

facts.value: All provisionally admitted applicants must take and pass the DSH-2 examination by the beginning of the semester.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro, and Finance

facts.value: Applicants must complete all examination performances of their Bachelor's degree before the summer semester preceding their start in the Master's program.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro, and Finance

facts.value: The semester contribution for the Master's program is approximately 350 € per semester.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro, and Finance

facts.value: Since the winter semester 2008/09, no tuition fees are required.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro, and Finance

facts.value: The ranking of applicants is based on a value derived 60% from the grade of the required degree and 40% from the grade of the study exposé.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro, and Finance

facts.value: Examinations completed at another university will generally only be recognized if they were completed no more than five calendar years before beginning the Master's program.
facts.programme_association: Master in Money, Macro, and Finance

facts.value: A provisional admission may be made under the condition of completing additional credits from the Bachelor's degree in Educational Science up to a maximum of 60 CP for applicants with a business-related Bachelor's degree.
